question.text: How many principles are enumerated under India's National Guidelines on Responsible Business Conduct (NGRBC) issued by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Table 6.2, NGRBC contains 9 principles covering integrity and governance, sustainable goods/services, employee well-being, stakeholder responsiveness, human rights, environment protection, responsible policy advocacy, inclusive growth and consumer value. They were issued in 2011 (as NVGs), revised in 2015 to align with SDGs. The Trap: 7 is fabricated. 10 is UNGC. 17 is SDGs. Only 9 is correct for NGRBC. Cross-Exam Context: III-A Compliance and Companies Act compliance syllabi reference NGRBC-aligned BRSR disclosures for top-1000 listed companies. XXIII is the SIA-side application. Assessor's Pro-Tip: NGRBC is non-legally enforceable (criticised in Ch 6) — so your SIA opinion should rely on SAS-specific evidence, with NGRBC used only as a framing narrative in the AIR introduction.
